subject: Request: Recovery assurance snapshot & RPO/KV logs
messages:
From: Olivia Marsh <olivia.marsh@steadfastbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Recovery assurance snapshot & RPO/KV logs

Hi Ben / Marissa,

We're working through the SIG/CAIQ follow-up for Steadfast's procurement team. The compliance reviewers asked for a compact "recovery assurance" packet showing recent RTO/RPO measurements and a short sample of KV-warm times (for prefix-warm behavior) from last week's tabletop. Specifically they want:

- RTO/RPO test timestamps and observed durations for the May 9 tabletop (end-to-end)
- A CSV with KV cache warm timings by service (approx. 10 rows is fine)
- A playbook excerpt that lists failover activation steps and post-failover validation checks

If possible, can you provide the artifacts as downloadable links and call out any manual steps we should expect during a live witness? We're aiming to get everything into the SIG follow-up by Friday.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Olivia Marsh
Head of Vendor Risk
Steadfast Bank
olivia.marsh@steadfastbank.com

[Attachment: formal-SIG-followup-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Marsh <olivia.marsh@steadfastbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Recovery assurance snapshot & RPO/KV logs

Hi Olivia — thanks for the list. We're collecting the requested artifacts now. High level:

- I'll attach a CSV export of KV warm timings and a compact playbook excerpt.
- The full runbook snapshot is a larger export (I'll place it in a short-lived S3 path and share the link).
- For a witness session, expect a ~30 minute demo: trigger failover, show target restore, then validate a small set of smoke checks. There are two manual steps (keystore handover and operator approval) we will call out.

I'll follow up in a separate email with the links and the S3 path.

Ben Carter

Olivia — adding a few specifics and the link to the runbook snapshot. See below:

S3 artifacts (short lived): https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-artifacts/proof/steadfast/20270509/
Contents: runbook-snapshots-20270509.jsonl (full export), playbook-excerpt-recovery-steps.pdf (3 pages), rpo-kv-warm-times-20270509.csv

Quick notes on the CSV columns: service, node, timestamp_utc, warm_ms, sequence_id. The warm times are measured during prefix population (simulated traffic) and tend to fall between 120ms-820ms depending on service and region.

For the witness: propose Wed 2027-05-14 10:00am PT. Agenda — 1) 10m overview of the failover flow, 2) live trigger and operator steps, 3) 10m validation and Q&A. We'll keep logs open and provide a copy of the replay transcript after the session.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — the S3 link and proposed cadence look good. A couple of follow-ups from the review team after they scanned the CSV:

- Can you annotate which entries correspond to cross-region traffic? We need to separate intra-region vs cross-region warm times.
- For the operator approval step, can you clarify whether that is ACL-based in our console or requires an on-call token exchange? We need to include that precision in our SIG answers.

Also — please confirm the retention snapshot for the replay logs (how long do you keep the compressed telemetry for a tabletop). If you can include that in the short packet it would help close the loop.

If you confirm availability for Wed 5/14 10am PT we'll lock the invite.

Olivia

Subject: Re: Request: Recovery assurance snapshot & RPO/KV logs

Olivia — confirmed for Wed 5/14 10:00am PT. Final packet attached and quick answers inline: 

- Cross-region flag: we've added a column "cross_region" to the CSV (values: true/false) and annotated the rows in the S3 copy. The sample in the attachment includes both intra- and cross-region rows.
- Operator approval: this is an ACL-based approval in the customer's control plane; for witness sessions we simulate the token exchange but the step is a single operator click in our Console UI. We'll demonstrate the click and the audit log entry during the session.
- Replay retention: compressed telemetry replays are retained for 30 days by default; we can export a longer retention package on request (we noted this in the playbook excerpt).

Attachments included: rpo-kv-warm-times-20270509.csv, playbook-excerpt-recovery-steps.pdf, runbook-snapshots-20270509.jsonl
